column3: Gist: The sacrificer saw the dung-smoke near and, beyond it, the fire; the priests prepared Soma; those rites were the first. Alternatively, an older story of the gods and a cloud.
column4: शकमयं ... (Sanskrit Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya block, no Kannada rendering given)
column5: An English gist of the Sanskrit commentary is supplied although the Kannada gives no translation of that block.
